measurement: SKIP_PATH_RE is one cross-detector rule: identical in all six detectors, applied before any prefilter, disclosed until now only as two secrets-exposure lines; measured on three pinned repositories with the shipped gate
spendNote: The instrument is the shipped SecretsExposureDetector, which has no model-reaching path (registry constructs it with no options; llmValidation false). It refuses to start with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set. The path gate it runs is the same regex, byte for byte, as the other five detectors' (grep of the six files: identical literal).
theBound: Each detector's detect() drops a file with preFilterReason 'path filter' when its path matches /(^|\/)(test|tests|__tests__|spec|fixtures|examples?|scripts|dev-tools|migrations?|seed|seeds|demo)(\/|$)/i. Whole path segments, case-insensitive. Neither entry point adds a path rule: src/cli/file-walker.ts DEFAULT_SKIP_DIRS is dependency/build/editor directories only; the GitHub App path (whole-file-scan-input, pr-webhook-handler, auditor-workflow) filters nothing by path.

instrument.what: SecretsExposureDetector.detect() over a synthetic diff containing every git-tracked file with a supported extension (ts, tsx, js, jsx, py, go) at the pinned commit, one trivial line each; the diag reason per path is the measurement.

controlsPerRun.C1_positive: tests/a.ts -> 'path filter'. PASS on all three runs.
controlsPerRun.C2_negative: src/routes/a.ts -> 'no regex match' (not filtered). PASS on all three runs.
controlsPerRun.C3_second_way: the instrument's dropped set is SET-EQUAL (not merely count-equal) to an independent regex copy's set. PASS on all three runs.
controlsPerRun.extra: SCRIPTS/x.py -> filtered (case-insensitive confirmed); src/spec.ts -> not filtered (file name is not a segment).

whatThisDoesNotEstablish: The share of any given customer's first-party code under these segments. Three repositories with three different conventions gave 21%, 5% and 6% of supported files; those are three points, not a distribution, and are deliberately not averaged.
boundToTheCode: Goes false if any of the six regexes diverges from the others, if a shared constant replaces them, or if either entry point gains a path rule.
reproduction: Zero spend. Enumerate git ls-files at the commit, filter to the six extensions, feed as a synthetic diff to SecretsExposureDetector.detect(), count lastDiagnostics with preFilterReason 'path filter'.
